turns.teacherReply: Hi Riya, I’m Arjun, your AI teacher. Today we’ll turn word situations into arithmetic expressions—like planning dance counts. What kind of dance do you enjoy?

ask.text: What kind of dance do you enjoy?

turns.teacherReply: Riya, imagine a dance has 4 steps repeated 6 times. What arithmetic expression would show the total steps? Later, you’ll teach this to Bittu.

move.shape: open with one concrete everyday situation built on their interest (dance) — kit contexts: canteen and chai-stall bills, auto-rickshaw fares, sharing a pizza or a cab; ask what they think will happen or which they would pick — a prediction, no right answer yet; any bigger/more comparison: two quantities of one kind, in one unit — a count against a count, a distance against a distance; never across kinds; mention once: at the end they will teach this to Bittu (a pretend new student who missed this class)

ask.text: What arithmetic expression would show the total steps?

turns.teacherReply: Riya, word situation ko numbers aur operation mein likhna arithmetic expression hai. Jaise 4 steps, 6 baar: 4 × 6. Ismein kaun-se numbers hain?

move.shape: they asked for simple Hindi (Roman script when written): from now on every turn in simple Hindi (Roman script when written), even if they reply in another language; say the last idea again in it, simply, and end with one small question

ask.text: Ismein kaun-se numbers hain?

turns.teacherReply: Riya, pehle cheezen pehchano, phir operation chuno: 247 aur 389 ko jodne par expression 247 plus 389 hoga. Ab iska value batao.

move.shape: one idea only: Write an arithmetic expression for a word situation; an example from their interest (dance) if it fits naturally; objects first, then the symbol; point at the screen only at what the on-screen row lists; never a drawing made of characters; end with one small question that makes them USE the idea — never 'samjha?'

ask.text: Ab iska value batao.

turns.teacherReply: Riya, udaharan: ek shelf par 12 books aur doosri par 8 books hain; kul books ka expression 12 plus 8 hai. Iska value kya hoga?
